description: This Java class 'LayoutMetadata' provides utility methods for handling layout-related metadata in Android development, including retrieving and setting properties on XML nodes, creating adapter bindings, and managing layout references.

classes.name: LayoutMetadata
classes.description: Utility class for managing layout metadata, including property retrieval, adapter binding creation, and property setting in Android layout XML files.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a specified property value from an XmlPullParser, Node, or XmlTag.

methods.name: stripLayoutPrefix
methods.description: Removes '@layout/' or '@android:layout/' prefix from a layout reference string.

methods.name: getNodeBinding
methods.description: Creates an AdapterBinding for a view object based on provided metadata or XmlTag.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets or clears a property on an XmlTag, updating related resource variations accordingly.
